text: Ginette Justal is a Breton residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Ginalir is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Ginereth is a Bosmer found on the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Ghelos is an Argonian farmer residing in Dhalmora. He can be found inside Baseenar's House, and has no unique dialogue.
Gideelar is an Argonian residing in Stormhold. She can be located southeast of the fighters guild shoveling by a tall pillar or raking in front of the Under-Root Bank.
Gin-Wan is an Argonian smith who can be found at Fort Amol. She has no unique dialogue.
Glanil is a Bosmer residing inside Halsinan's house in Orsinium.
Gladiator Brute is a creature that appears in the Blessed Crucible in .
Ghazana is a Redguard member of the Thieves Guild, residing in the Thieves Den within the city of Abah's Landing.
Zufthalg is a friendly Scamp that appears in Fizengig's Trading Emporium in the Hollow City.
Gilustulm is an Argonian woodworker found at a table outside the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City.

Gilan Lerano is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, Vvardenfell, in . He works for a Telvanni mage Master Drenim. Gilan Lerano is married to Bravora Faren, with whom he has two children: Mils Lerano and Neria Lerano.
Gladiator Ethes is a Dunmer warrior residing in the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City.
Gladiator Fezreba is a Khajiit soldier found adjacent to the Battlegrounds Housing Goods in the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City.
Gladiator Renkathi is a Dunmer warrior residing in the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City.
Gladiator Tourima is a Redguard hunter residing in the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City. She is originally from Abah's Landing.
Gladiator Toris is a Dunmer warrior residing in the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City.

Gladiator Daynes is a Dunmer exercising near the docks in Vivec City. He can be found doing push-ups and jumping jacks with Gladiator Runaki near the marketplace hub, but will return to the Gladiator's Quarters afterwards.

Gladiator Runaki is a Redguard residing near the docks in Vivec City. She may be found doing push-ups and jumping jacks with Gladiator Daynes near the marketplace hub, but will return to the Gladiator's Quarters afterwards.
Gilbara Morrard is a Breton chef working at the Waistworks Eating House within the Brewers and Fishmongers Hall in the Saint Olms Waistworks of Vivec City.
Gladiator Balahkath is an Argonian gladiator residing at the Foyada Quarry.
Gladiator Eesamelle is a Breton soldier residing at the Foyada Quarry.
Gjomee-Loh is an Argonian slave residing in Tel Aruhn, in Vvardenfell.
Ginette Malarelie is a Breton guild trader and propritor of Shrinefire Market in Balmora, Vvardenfell.

Girin is a Bosmer residing in Driladan Pass. He is acquainted with Indaenir and warns the pilgrims from venturing deeper into the forest during an attack by undead. He can be seen near Echo Pond, and South-East from the Dread Vullain a little West of the crossroad.
Gilyan Dredil is a Dunmer residing at the Falensarano Ruins on Vvardenfell, Morrowind. He can be seen digging the debris in front of the western's building's entrance. He has no unique dialogue.
Gladiator Narese is a Dunmer gladiator residing in Ald Carac. She can be found near the tent on the eastern side of the camp. She has no unique dialogue.
Gladiator Orenthel is a Dunmer gladiator residing in Ald Carac.
Gladiator Vaoldelf is a Nord gladiator residing in Ald Carac.
Gladiator Yamukuz is an Orsimer gladiator residing in Ald Carac.
The Ghost Viper Deadeye is a member of the Ghost Vipers at the Wreck of the Raptor. This enemy accompanies Captain Blanchete and will attack you upon sight.
The Ghost Viper Tempest is a member of the Ghost Vipers at the Wreck of the Raptor. This enemy accompanies Captain Blanchete and will attack you upon sight.
Glagosh is an Orsimer born of the Shatul Clan residing in Shatul Range, Wrothgar. She was once the hunt-wife of Chief Ogzor.
Lord Ghol is one of the lower lords of Umbriel. His residence is called the Ghol Manor. He is the patron of Qijne's kitchen.
Galms Galen is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. They have no unique dialogue
Gideon Emery (born September 12, 1972) is an British voice actor who provided the voices for many Imperial characters in , and Dunmer characters . __NOTOC__
Glanoyar is an Altmer who can be found in Ceporah Tower in Artaeum. He cannot be interacted with.
Gilbonil is an Bosmer found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. She has no unique dialogue.
Glamalg is an Orsimer in who is working at Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil.
Gemma Invel is a Dunmer member of the Black Fin Legion in who resides near The Stable Steed in Gideon.
Girchta is a Redguard nobleman in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.
Gir-Ta is an Argonian guild trader residing at the Lilmoth Outlaws Refuge in Lilmoth.
Gierry Chatillon is a Breton traveler in . He can be found along with Finuya at one of their possible locations accross the High Isle.

Glenroy was an Imperial and a member of the Blades. He was also one of the Emperor's bodyguards. He serves as a minor antagonist in , and is unique due to him being the only minor antagonist in the Storyline, and the only antagonist within the Blades.

Goblins are small, but tough, humanoid creatures in . They are a bit shorter in size than the average Mer. Goblins are blue or green skinned, with bulbous eyes. Most goblins are part of a goblin clan that congregates around a certain location, particularly caves and mines, but they also may be found living in sewers or various ruins. The weapons they wield are generally based upon the Hero's level.

Glonagoth is an unemployed Bosmer Herder who resides in Hla Oad. He does not actually mind being unemployed though, finding his newfound leisure time rather pleasing. Glonagoth does not offer any services, and is not involved in any quests.
Glarthir is an insane Bosmer commoner, who suffers from a severe case of paranoia, living in Skingrad. Residents seem to ignore him, as long as he is not being disruptive or harmful.
Goblin Jim is a Breton that can be found with his goblin allies in Goblin Jim's Cave.

Glistel is a Dunmer living in Malintus Ancrus' House on the southwest side of Chorrol. She is an Apprentice sneak trainer and a member of the Thieves Guild. She begins training at 3:00 P.M. in her home.
A Goblin Witch is a goblin which can be found in the Imperial Prison, Natural Caverns. It is the only one to exist.
Gleda is a prize-winning goat belonging to Ennis, a farmer in Rorikstead.
Gloth is a Nord farmer in who lives and works at Pelagia Farm. He has no unique dialogue.
Gluronk gra-Shula is an Orsimer Assassin thrall for the Morag Tong living in the Gateway Inn, at Sadrith Mora.

Glover Mallory is a Breton blacksmith living in Raven Rock, on Solstheim. He is the father of Sapphire, brother of Delvin Mallory, and a member of the Thieves Guild. He is found at the Blacksmith's shop upon first arriving at Raven Rock. Just like the other villagers of the town, he can also be found at the Earth Stone working on it and worshiping at it. When he does, he acts and sounds like he has been indoctrinated.
Glasha gra-Magar is an Orsimer barbarian residing in the Dwemer Ruin of Mzuleft.
Glush gro-Dul is an Orsimer Agent and worshipper of Malacath, residing in the cave of Shashpilamat.

Glob gra-Ghasharzol is an Orsimer Barbarian who resides in the region of Sheogorad located within Morrowind. She is found west of the Dwemer Ruins of Mzuleft at a statue of Malacath with three other Orcs, Urzog gro-Shadbuk, Bugharz gro-Ular, and Murzol gro-Ulfimph.
Glurnt is an Orsimer who resides in Betnikh. He is one of the characters found in King Renwic's vision.

Gloria Fausta is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra, in . She has been kidnapped along with the Duke and is when first met, in a cottage by the lighthouse. Unknown to most, Fausta is a descendant of the fanatic Faolchu, an Alessian General and werewolf responsible for the Battle of Glenumbra Moors against the Direnni Elves of the region in the First Era. She will make an appearance during the Camlorn questline, only if Lineage of Tooth and Claw is completed before The Fall of Faolchu and if she survives the player's choice.
Glaum is a Bosmer bandit hunter residing in the Telvayn Ancestral Tomb. He will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Glurala the Wise is an Orsimer near Stonetooth Fortress on the isle of Betnikh in . She is the mother of Chief Tazgol and the grandmother of Lokra.
Glauloroth is a Bosmer beggar residing in The Middens beneath Elden Root.
Glurduk gra-Bol is an Orsimer residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She looks after the chickens beside the Aldcroft Fighters Guild, and is very protective of them.
Gnush is an Orsimer residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. During waking hours, she is typically found near or at Dayagwen's stall, Quiver & Crook, at the local marketplace.

Gobani is a female Senche-Tiger in . She and her sisters, Afeh and Marapa, should be cleaning the Laughing Moons Plantation of rats, but have become too lazy to do so after consuming rats who had been feeding on moon sugar. Her handler is Cinder-Tail. She appears again at the Redfur Trading Post with Cinder-Tail during the quest "Flipping the Coin."
Gloraneth is a Bosmer pack merchant residing at her stall, Gloraneth's Gunnysacks, in the city of Marbruk.
Glegokh is an Orsimer guild trader residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth.
Glorgzorgo is an Orsimer guild trader residing in the city of Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai.
Glath gra-Bol is an Orsimer residing on the island of Eyevea.

Glirion the Redbeard is a Bosmer residing in the cities of Elden Root, Mournhold, or Wayrest. He is a former Vinedusk Ranger, now a full-time Undaunted member. He used to give Veteran Pledges exclusively, although after Update 12, began giving Pledges of previous Veteran-leveled dungeons.
Glash gra-Dush is an Orsimer residing in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r.
Gnilokelo is a Dremora serving as the boss of The Cave of Trophies.
Glurdag is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Glathor is a Bosmer gatherer and patron of The Sleepy Eaglet in Skywatch.
Glaurilas is a Bosmer scholar of the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth. He is a Star-Gazer who was sent by Nazdura to find star maps.
Gloldor is a Bosmer mage residing in Longhaven. He says that is thinking about joining the Aldmeri Dominion.
Glooredel is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers found in their headquarters in Vinedusk Village.
Gloron is a Bosmer who resides in the city of Rawl'kha, in the region of Reaper's March.
Glothorien is a Bosmer priest of Y'ffre seeking to restore the ruins of Gil-Var-Delle to its former glory.
Glothozug is an Orsimer guild trader selling his wares at his stall, Glothie's Sellcart, in Southpoint.
Glud Two-Axes is an Orsimer member of the Fighters Guild and the armsman of the hall of Arenthia.
Gluineth is a Bosmer adventurer who has been captured by the Trolls found in the Troll's Toothpick.
Glushonkh is an Orsimer fence working at In-the-Clear Fencing in the Elden Root Outlaws Refuge in Grahtwood.
Gnaws-on-Tail is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. She is looking for help in saving her master, Skyward-Eyes, who has gone insane and went into hiding in Arlimahera's Grip for mysterious reasons.
Gobur One-Eye is an Orsimer member of the Undaunted found with his companions at The Withered Tree in Riften. The Vestige can buy him a drink as part of This One's On Me achievement.
Gluth is an Orsimer member of the Barkbite Clan residing in the city of Reman's Bluff, Grahtwood.
Glorgoloch the Destroyer is a powerful flesh colossus found in the Arena District of the ruined Imperial City. It is one of the twelve Patrolling Horrors in .
Glurala gra-Ulat is an Orsimer residing in Cropsford, Cyrodiil.
The Gnarl Rootbender is a creature in . It is a form of Gnarl.
Glendora is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild found in the Hollow City's Mages Guildhall in Coldharbour.
Goburbak is an Orsimer found in the city of Orsinium. He is impossible to interact with, but can be seen talking to Auguste Barthel.
Glutton is a pig that appears in Daggerfall. Glutton is key in the quest "Swine Thief" in which his owner Wickton tasks the Vestige in tracking down Glutton and bringing him back.
Gluthesh is an Orsimer found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Goblin Officer is a high ranked goblin of Mournhold found in .
Goblin Handler is a high ranked goblin of Mournhold found in .
Gnaw-Bone is a Goblin of the Rock Bone Tribe. He is found with his fellow tribesmen at their camp near Vlastarus.
Gnaea Caledonia is an Imperial bard in who resides in Cheydinhal.
Glaz is an Orsimer residing in Abah's Landing. He can also be found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge.
Glenmoril Guardian is a Wolf found in Viridian Woods. It serves the Glenmoril Wyrd.
Glenmoril Wyress is a generic member of the Glenmoril Wyrd found in Jackdaw Cove. They can be found in this location after the Dark Witnesses' forces are defeated. They cannot be interacted with.
Glolbikla is an Orsimer member of the Evermore City Guard. She is part of the squad sent to investigate the troubles of Murcien's Hamlet.
Gnaw-Root Butchers are goblin foot soldiers of the Gnaw-Root Tribe, found in Mud Tree Village, Shadowfen.
The Gnaw-Root Warchief is the goblin leader of the Gnaw-Root Tribe, and holds his tribe's totem.
Goblin Caster is a creature that appears in . They are encountered by the Fugitive in both quests and the Abyss.
Glenora is a Bosmer member of the Star-Gazers who can be found just outside the Sanctum Ophidia. She stands near the entrance to the Sanctum and attempts to dissuade the Vestige from entering.
Gloorz is an Orsimer mugger residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. He appears to be robbing Inisargo. He has no dialogue.
Glastke is a Redguard mage in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.

King Gortwog gro-Nagorm is King of the Orsinium Area, and the leader of the Orcish people during the late Third Era. Since his ascension to the throne, he has worked hard to make his people be accepted as citizens of the Empire. He is also strongly against Necromancy.

King Gothryd (3E 381 – ???) was the King of Daggerfall. His father, Lysandus of Daggerfall, was killed at the end of the War for Betony in 3E 403, Gothryd was crowned to replace him. His wife is Aubk-i, former princess of Sentinel, who he married in 3E 404. His mother is Mynisera and his grandmother is Nulfaga. While his father was said to have been very loyal of the Third Empire, it is implied Gothryd himself was not, as a Blades operative declared that if Gothryd obtained both the Mantella and the Totem of Tiber Septim, Tamriel would be thrown into a civil war. In spite of this, in the timeline where Gothryd obtains both items, Daggerfall only destroys Wayrest and Sentinel to gain control

Golden Saints, also known as Aureals, are Daedra that serve as protectors of the Mania region of the Shivering Isles. They appear in the , as well as in , as both summonable creatures and as Daedra that appear in Daedric shrines (depending on the level of the Hero). It is possible to obtain the help of the Saints in order to light the Flame of Agnon.
Godros is a Bosmer Agent living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Gorchalas is a Bosmer Sharpshooter living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni and can be found in the upper tower.
Golven Hleran is a Dunmer witchhunter and member of House Redoran living in the Redoran Stronghold of Marandus.

Goron Lleran is a Dunmer pilgrim who resides in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He is a novice member of the Tribunal Temple who can be found at the St. Veloth's Hostel atop the city. Goron is not involved in any quests.
Goldyn Belaram is a Dunmer Pawnbroker and proprietor of Goldyn Belaram: Pawnbroker in Suran.
Gogron gro-Bolmog is an Orsimer assassin and member of the Cheydinhal Sanctuary of the Dark Brotherhood encountered in .
Gorgo gro-Shura is an Orsimer and an Anvil resident. Residing in Jesan Sextius' House, he is an unemployed mercenary who spends his time wandering in the city.

Gogan is a Redguard guard for the city of Anvil. He is married to Maelona. He and Maelona are undercover guards who have been trying to take down a gang of seductresses, who lure men into their home at Gweden Farm, and rob them of their valuables. As the men were ashamed, they would not respond to interview by the guards. As a result, they pretend that Gogan was robbed of his ring by the women and Maelona will ask the Hero to help get it back for them. Gogan can be found at his house in the west side of Anvil, the house is open after 6:00pm.
Godrod Hairy-Breeks is a Nord barbarian residing in Ulummusa.
Gorm is a Nord in who is the bodyguard of Jarl Idgrod Ravencrone of Morthal.

Archmagister Gothren is a Councilor and the Archmagister of House Telvanni and Lord High Magus of the Telvanni Council. Despite being the Archmagister, he does not reside in Sadrith Mora, the Telvanni capital on Vvardenfell, but can instead be found in his tower of Tel Aruhn, near Sadrith Mora. His Mouth and representative is Mallam Ryon.
Goler Andrethi is a Dunmer and member of House Telvanni. He resides in Tel Vos in Vvardenfell, Morrowind.

Gorieus was an Emperor in the First Era. He was crowned in 1E 461 on the 23rd of Sun's Dawn. Gorieus was the general of the Alessian Army, and was responsible for the downfall of Kjoric the White at the Battle of Sungard. However, he was unable to stop the king of Skingrad, Rislav Larich, who rebelled against him, and defeated him. Later, this would inspire Hoag Merkiller and Wulfharth of Atmora, as well as Ryain Direnni and the Direnni Bloodline.
Gomeso Sarano is a Dunmer trader who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton. Gomeso trades miscellaneous items.
Golana Giralvel is a Dunmer archer who can be found in the Sudanit Mine. She is a member of House Redoran.
Golar Omoran is a Dunmer bandit knight, and resides in the cave of Sanabi. He is a bandit and is hostile to the Nerevarine.
Gols Nilvon is a Dunmer pilgrim who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Goren Andarys is a Dunmer Monk, and Morag Tong member. He can be found in the Morag Tong Guildhall in Ald'ruhn.
Lord Graddock was the Redguard ruler of Reich Gradkeep during the War of Betony.
Golmerea Othravel is a Dunmer archer who resides in the cave of Ahinipalit, in the region of Molag Amur.
Golveso Senim is a Dunmer monk who resides in the Waistworks of the Telvanni Canton. She is a trainer in Acrobatics (up to 44), Sneak (up to 44) and Hand-to-Hand (up to 44).
Golvyni Faryon is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Gorenea Andrano is a Dunmer Sorcerer who resides in Sud on the island of Sheogorad along with Anirne.

Gordhaur the Shaper was an Ayleid King of the city of Ninendava in Cyrodiil, which at the time was controlled by the Ayleids. In 1E 242, Gordhaur was challenged to a duel by Pelinal Whitestrake, a champion of the Nedic slaves of the Ayleids. Whitestrake killed Gordhaur by smashing his head on a goat-faced altar at Ninendava.
Gort is a Nord ferryman. He and his rowboat are located at the Windhelm docks.
Goval Ralen is a Dunmer who can be found in Temple Courtyard, in Mournhold. He is one of three potential candidates for Marena Gilnith to go out with.
Gonk gra-Gurub is an Orsimer Warrior who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton. She is found in the Telvanni Temporary Housing, just off the Telvanni Plaza.
Gorg is a champion of the Toothmaul Gully public dungeon. Killing this creature counts towards the "Toothmaul Gully Conqueror" and the "Toothmaul Gully Vanquisher" achievements.
Golbag is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He walks around the dead bodies near the docks.
Goramalg gro-Dushnikh is an Orsimer residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found around Daggerfall Docks.
Grace Paumier is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Hallin's Stand.
Goveled Herendas is a Dunmer prostitute working at The Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.
Gorsha gra-Bumolg is an Orsimer residing on the island of Eyevea.
Govyth Areloth is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu. He resides inside their kinhouse in Narsis.
Gothurg is an Orsimer residing in the city of Shornhelm, Rivenspire.
Grackle is a durzog residing at the Fighters guildhall in the city of Windhelm, Eastmarch.
Gogvir Flat-Foot is a Nord found in Windhelm. He is one of the participants of The Konunleikar, race taking place in the city.
Goh is an Orsimer guild trader who sells his wares at the Trunkshade Traders in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Golg gro-Goldog is an Orsimer of the Murtag Clan aiding General Godrun in his campaign against the Ironhand Ogres at Shinji's Scarp.
Golor the Banekin Handler is a Bosmer worshipper of the Daedra found in the City of Ash.
Golun Drenduf is a Dunmer in who serves as the court mage for Thane Fjora, the woman in charge of Nimalten.
Golvy is a Dunmer siege merchant and a member of the Ebonheart Pact. She sells her wares at the Southern Morrowind Gate.
Goorga gra-Shugduk is an Orsimer found in Shornhelm, Rivenspire.
Goorgul is an Orsimer traveling merchant found on the road south of Shinji's Scarp.
Goralas Sendu is a Dunmer residing at Shad Astula in Deshaan.
Gorgath Deadeye is an Orsimer tracking down Varnedo, a Redguard fugitive.
Gorgrolg is an Orsimer member of the Undaunted residing at their enclave outside of the city of Mournhold. Deshaan.
Gorinir is a Bosmer and one of the joint leaders of the second Blacksap Rebellion, along with his brother Lorchon.
Gorotho gro-Dulak is an Orsimer mercenary merchant of the Covenant found at the Northern High Rock Gate.
Gorvyn Dran is a Dunmer from Quarantine Serk travelling to Stonefalls to warn them about the Llodos Plague ravaging Deshaan.
Gothrongor is a Bosmer who has been captured by the Wood Orcs of the Bloodtoil Valley.
Goudadul is a Redguard guild trader selling her wares at The Marbruk Mart in Marbruk.
Gourdeez is a Redguard merchant part of the group of outlaws found in the refuge beneath Stormhold.
Grabash is an Orsimer merchant who sells her wares at the Watchtower Tavern in the town of Vlastarus, Cyrodiil.
Gorbakh is an Orsimer priest of Trinimac found in the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium. He is impossible to interact with.

King Golkarr gro-Igrun, colloquially known as the "Orc of Wiles," was the ruler of the First Orsinium during the mid-to-late 10th century of the First Era after he succeeded Torug gro-Igron. His reign ended in 1E 980, when he was slain at the hands of his enemies, marking the end of the 30-year Siege of Orsinium. He was often described as being a zealot over the Daedric Prince Malacath.
Gohazgu is an Orsimer grocer found outside Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.
Gogul is an Orsimer found in Chief Abzug's Longhouse in the Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar. She is impossible to interact with.
Gom-Tulm is an Argonian sailor residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.

Provincial Governor Fortunata ap Dugal, also known as the Pirate Queen and Captain ap Dugal, is the Imperial leader of a pirate crew known as the Red Sails and the current ruler of Anvil. She is also the sister of Codus ap Dugal, the gamemaster of the Kvatch Arena, although the latter prefers to deny that fact in order to keep face and his clean reputation.
Gorbu is an Orsimer found wondering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. Killing him will result in a bounty.

Goradir is a large dragon skull located in Bone Orchard, a large cemetery in the southern area of Grahtwood. He is one of Dringoth's friends who can be interacted with by the Vestige after they find him at the dig site that was being used by the Worm Cult to raise an undead army.
Golden Saint Aurgezel is a Golden Saint in . She patrols the paths between the Gates of Madness and Bliss, Hale and the Gates of Madness, Split and Hale, Highcross and Split and Bliss and Highcross.
Godadras is a Bosmer hunter in who resides in Vulkwasten. He has no unique dialogue.
Golar Thindo is a Dunmer priest found in Iliath Temple. He has no unique dialogue.
Gornog is a Goblin and a warchief of the Dogeater Tribe. He is found inside the Goblin Mines on Stros M'Kai.
Gozzak is a Spider Daedra and the boss of Mephala's Nest. Her unique drop is the Shadowsilk Headwrap of the Sun.
Gold Coast Agent is a generic character residing in Garlas Agea.
Gonbubal is an Orsimer laborer found outside the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City. She offers no unique dialogue.
Goras is a Dunmer sailor found at the docks in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Gollgarth is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Gols Ginith is a Dunmer mage residing outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. He offers no unique dialogue.
Goron Romoren is a Dunmer laborer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He is husband to Mivanu Romoren. He has no unique dialogue.
Gothemril is a Bosmer found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
The Golden Knight is a character found outside Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion, Shimmerene during a particular stage of the quest "The Queen's Decree." He wears Auroran armor and wields Dawnbreaker.
Gohjin-jo is a Khajiit found at the Sunspire temple in Northern Elsweyr.
Gold Coast Scout is a character located in Kozanset, Alik'r Desert, in .
Gornikaus Oxtooth is a minotaur delve boss that appears at the Tomb of the Serpents in . He was lured into the tomb along with other minotaurs by the hex placed on the relics there.
Gordyn Bachand is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, in Stormhaven. He is the brewer at the Old Goat Inn, where he sells his wares.
Gondistair is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. During waking hours, he is usually found browsing at the local marketplace, but more particularly at the stall of Dumurzog.

Graman gro-Marad is an Orsimer and the bouncer on the Bloated Float. He can be found residing in his house in the Temple District of the Imperial City. During the quest "An Unexpected Voyage," Graman is locked in the storage room by the Blackwater Brigands.

Udico was a Dark Seducer in during the Fourth Era Greymarch, where she held the rank of Grakendo, an officer grade equivalent to captain. When the Forces of Order launched their first salvo against the Shivering Isles, Udico may or may not have led the defense alongside the Hero.

Grakedrig Ulfri is the commander of the Dark Seducers. She lives in Cylarne located on The Isle of Flame, in the northwestern part of Shivering Isles. The Hero can choose to side with her or with Aurmazl Kaneh during the quest "The Cold Flame of Agnon."
Gralnach is a Nord child who lives at Heartwood Mill with his mother Grosta, located in The Rift. His father is Leifnarr, who has gone missing.

Graklak gro-Buglump is an Orsimer who resides in the town of Skingrad. He can frequently be found in the West Weald Inn as this is his place of residence. He has no particular greeting, but is more than happy to tell you about Skingrad.
Gragus Lleran is a Dunmer Assassin and member of the Morag Tong residing in Sarethi Manor.

Grahkrindrog (Dragon Language: Grah–Krin–Drog, "Battle–Courageous–Lord") was a dragon that once resided in the province of Skyrim. It was killed during the Second Era in 2E 184. It was responsible for a great deal of slaughter in the Holds of Eastmarch and Winterhold. The name of this dragon was confirmed later with the help of the College of Winterhold.
Grazob gra-Kharz is a hostile Orsimer Warrior and Daedra worshipper found at Assurdirapal.

Gratian Caerellius is an Imperial commoner and member of the East Empire Company living in the mine at Raven Rock. He is one of three colonists available to become a guard in Raven Rock for the quest "Hiring Guards." He met his demise some time later in the bowels of Raven Rock mine along with his assistant Millius soon after discovering the Bloodskal Blade, from wounds he sustained fighting Draugr. The East Empire Company covered this up and claimed his death had been the result of a tragic accident.
Granny Varis is a Dunmer caretaker who can be found in the reception area of the Mournhold Temple. She is married to Gee-Pop Varis and Trels Varis is one of her sons.
Graring is a Nord barbarian who resides at his house on the Felsaad Coast of Solstheim.
Grat gra-Sharolg is an Orsimer Warrior residing in the stronghold of Valenvaryon.
Grand Shaman Glazgor is an Orsimer shaman, and a member of the Oathbound Clan. He may be found in the Obsidian Scar, Rivenspire.
Granette Feldrin is a Breton residing in at the Shrieking Scar, Glenumbra, in . She is the sister of Gelvin Feldrin.

Grand Warlord Zimmeron is a Dunmer and commander of the Ebonheart Pact's forces in Cyrodiil during the Three Banners War. He has two subordinates, Nord General Jeggord and Argonian General Dar-Liurz. He provides quests to either recapture the Pact Scrolls of Chim and Ghartok if they have been taken, or to capture the enemy Scrolls of Altadoon, Mnem, Alma Ruma or Ni-Mohk. If all six Scrolls are in Pact hands, he will simply comment on this fact when spoken to.

Grand Warlord Dortene is a Breton commander of the Daggerfall Covenant's forces in Cyrodiil during the Three Banners War. She has two subordinates, Orsimer General Khamagash and Redguard General Am-Shadal.

Grand Warlord Sorcalin is a female Altmer and commander of the Aldmeri Dominion's forces in Cyrodiil during the Three Banners War. She has two subordinates, Bosmer General Thoron and Khajiit General Atahba.
Gran Struthe is a deceased creature in . The body of Gran Struthe can be found in Fort Scinia.
Gravel Trothgar is a merchant who can be found in Azra's Crossing, near the temple. He will open his store once "Rat Quest" is completed.
Grass-Eater is a Khajiit beggar residing in Belkarth's bazaar.
Grazubesha gra-Murtag is an Orsimer merchant residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth, in the Belkarth Outlaws Refuge. She is the author of Letter to Zurga gra-Murtag.
Graklha gra-Rug is an Orsimer clothier residing in the city of Rawl'kha, Reaper's March.
Grandee Kalvyn al-Sentinel is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Desert city of Bergama.
Grandeya Mirva is a Redguard in , found in the Alik'r Desert city of Bergama.
Grandee Husni is a Redguard in residing in the city of Sentinel in the Alik'r Desert.
Gravedigger Jacques is a Breton who resides in the town of Wind Keep. He is tasked with tending to the graves of the town's former residents.
Gralturg is an Orsimer refugee from Crestshade. He is currently staying in Camp Tamrith, Rivenspire.
Grandeya Nuwarrah is a Redguard and the grandeya of the city of Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in .
Granier Cornillac is a Breton pirate that was part of Captain Blackheart's crew before he became cursed.
Gratidia Arius is an Imperial soldier of the Legion of the West Weald. She is found wounded in Senalana.
Gravik gro-Murtag is an Orsimer member of the Murtag Clan aiding General Godrun in his campaign against the Ironhand Ogres at Shinji's Scarp.
Greca is a Nord traveling merchant. She sells her wares on the road between Fullhelm Fort and Riften.
Great Thorn is a powerful Spriggan found in the Root Sunder Ruins.
Grave Archer is a character residing in The Grave in Stros M'Kai.
Grave Butcher is a hostile Redguard who can be found at The Grave in Stros M'Kai.
The Greater Skinned Hound is a creature in . It is a form of Skinned Hound.
Grazda is an Orsimer assassin residing in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary or near the Gold Coast Wayshrine.
Grancis is a Breton member of the Saltwalker Militia. He is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Greedy-Gut is a Khajiit chef of the Baandari Clan. He sells his wares at his stall, Whisker-Lick Kitchen, in their camp at the Martyr's Crossing.
Grakguhl is an Orsimer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is located inside the Gnisis Mine Barracks. She has no unique dialogue.
Gray Viper Duelist is a generic duelist residing in several locations in .
Grand Sermonizer Fithia is a Redguard member of the Order of the Hour residing at the At-Himah Family Estate in Kvatch, Gold Coast.
Grand Fanatic Shurkol is the Orsimer leader of the Malacath Fanatics, who have stormed the Temple of Ire in the city of Orsinium.
Gravelight Sentry is a watcher in . It has a chance to drop a unique item, The Vigilant One.
Gray Viper Chillrender is a member of the Gray Vipers in Cyrodiil.
Graguz Fire-Caller is an Orsimer Vosh Rakh priest in . He is found at Paragon's Remembrance.
Gratorga is a Orsimer member of the Rimmen Fighters Guild in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. She can be found sleeping on a houseplant.
Beek-Shei is an Argonian member of the Moss-Skin Tribe residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Grand Maestro Forte is an Altmer in who resides at the Manor of Masques in Rellenthil, Summerset. He is the leader of the House of Reveries performance troupe.
Grashorag is an Orsimer merchant residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. She runs Grashorag's Goods.
Grakendo Dark Seducers are a Daedra featured in . They use new unique armors and weapons in the Dark Seducer style. The weapons are the Greatsword, Warhammer, and Battleaxe.
Gratia Fauseius is an Imperial in who resides outside of Leyawiin.

Gray Host Vampire Lords are generic vampire lords that can be encountered in Western Skyrim and the Reach. They appear as a final boss when all three witch pikes are destroyed during the harrowstorms.
Gravestalker Gemmia is an Imperial skullguard and member of the Euraxian Legion.
Grashuzag is an Orc located in Dreadsail Reef, High Isle and Amenos, in .
Grash is an Orsimer mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Alcaire Castle. She can be found at the local guildhall where she sells her wares.
Greklith was the second born prince of Sentinel, born to Queen Akorithi and King Camaron in 3E 392. He died near the end of the Third Era from a plague, leaving the throne to his brother, Lhotun.
Greidil Half-Troll is a Nord warrior living in her home on the west side of Dagon Fel, Morrowind. She wields a Steel Flamemace and is equipped with a few pieces of Bonemold armor.
Gruiand Garrana is an Imperial who lives in the Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal. She is a Journeyman level Speechcraft trainer.

Gregory Arne is a Breton rogue and a fanatical worshipper of the Madgod Sheogorath. He can be found at Sheogorath's Shrine. Like most of his fellow worshippers, Gregory is hardly concerned with clothing and thus only wears a Leather Cuirass. He also wields an Iron Dagger and carries a small amount of gold.
